svg.desc: O-01 opening scene decorative circular star-trail arcs, hand-built from SVG arc paths based on reference o-01-star-trails.png (not traced from a raster image). Two independently-rotatable groups: #o01-trails-inner and #o01-trails-outer, each built from many irregular-length arcs distributed across 9 radius bands (dense/short near center, sparse/long at edge) so the sky reads as densely wrapped rather than a few mechanical rings.
